sourceSentences: Active: Janna summons a whirlwind at her current location that charges up over 3 seconds, increasing its range, speed, damage, and airborne duration every second over the duration.
Howling Gale can be recast at any time within the duration, and does so automatically after the duration.
The storm does not interact with enemy units that stand on top of it while it is charging.
Active: Janna sends an air elemental at the target enemy that deals magic damage and slows them for 2 seconds, capped at 99%.
Passive: Whenever Janna's abilities slow or knock up at least one enemy champion, 20% of Eye of the Storm's cooldown is refunded. This may occur once per spell cast.
Active: Janna grants the target allied champion or turret, or herself, a shield for 4 seconds.
Janna receives kill credit on enemy champions that are killed by turrets shielded by Eye of the Storm.
Allied turrets will benefit from the bonus attack damage when targeted by Eye of the Storm.
Active: Janna unleashes a blast that knocks back all nearby enemies to up to 875 units over 0.5 seconds based on their proximity, though not through terrain.
Janna also channels for up to 3 seconds, healing herself and nearby allies every 0.25 seconds.
channel: attack=interrupts, cast=interrupts, move=interrupts, spells: Barrier Clarity Cleanse Exhaust Ghost Heal Ignite Smite usable, Flash interrupts
tornadoes out of the enemy's line of sight. I was coaching a player recently and he would charge a tornado out of sight and then just walk out into the open.
When you're being chased and you're in a tight spot trying to escape, you have to charge the tornado so that it comes back at you
And one more thing, charge it behind you if you're being chased or something.
Troisièmement, chargez votre tornade depuis les buissons. Si votre tornade est dissimulée hors de vue, l'ennemi aura beaucoup moins de chances de réagir.
faites attention si l'ennemi pose une balise dans les buissons. Ils pourront encore voir votre tornade.
comme des murs derrière lesquels l'ennemi n'a pas de visibilité, ou même vos propres tours. Vous pouvez en fait placer une tornade directement derrière votre tour
Conservez votre tornade et lancez-la instantanément dès que vous voyez la capacité que vous devez interrompre. Ce n'est pas grave si vous n'arrivez pas à charger complètement votre tornade.
utilisez votre capacité Zéphyr (W) pour ralentir l'ennemi pendant que vous chargez votre tornade. Votre lenteur les maintiendra plus longtemps à portée de votre tornade
Une tornade pleinement chargée a une portée, une vitesse, des dégâts et une durée de projection en l'air accrus.
Janna's level two is not that great and it's you don't really have a reliable engage only if you flash Q. So that's exactly what I did.
The way you want to cancel, the easiest way to cancel Allistar is you purposely put yourself into his range and then get a queue off.
Charging your Q towards the direction the enemy is walking away so you can get a longer knockup and it's faster
I go for an insect where I not an insect but I I ultistar into our tower.
Monsoon can also be used offensively by Flashing behind an enemy and ulting them into Janna's team.
Janna's Q knockup can interrupt Alistar's Headbutt mid-dash, preventing the Pulverize follow-up entirely.
The shield can also be cast on turrets, adding bonus AD to the turret's shots and a shield to protect it from siege damage.
